properties.summary: Illustrative massing: the 15 building parcels of the Draft EIR's site plan (Figure 2-9), each drawn whole at its proposed height limit (Figure 2-8): 85 ft on most parcels, 105 ft for the hotel, 165 ft on SW-A and SW-F, 185 ft on NE-D, 225 ft on SE-D and 335 ft on SE-A. These are envelopes, not building designs, which aren't final; the real buildings have courtyards and setbacks. Octavia Green isn't drawn.
properties.note: Proposed height limits over each building parcel, not buildings.

georeference.method: Figure 2-9 (250-dpi render) fitted to the DataSF parcel corners of Block 0783 and the Gough Street corners of lot 0770/027 (least-squares similarity).

properties.license: Parcel lines and heights: from a public SF Planning document. Lots: DataSF parcels (ODC-PDDL).

properties.label: Building NW-CO-OP
properties.use: Homes (267 replacement co-op homes), an innovation center, a community event space and shops
properties.source: illustrative: parcel traced from Freedom West 2.0 Draft EIR, Volume 1 (Case No. 2020-006887ENV, January 13, 2026), Figure 2-9 (PDF p. 147); height from Figure 2-8 (PDF p. 145) and Figure 2-10 (PDF p. 148)
properties.note: Parcel NW-CO-OP drawn whole at its proposed 85-ft height limit (Figure 2-8), an envelope rather than a building: the real building has courtyards, setbacks or a lower podium. The 267 replacement homes for Freedom West's co-op shareholders, built first (Phase 1A).
